rationale: This record is a brief guest-editor biographical profile of Pennsylvania's former Secretary of Aging focusing on elder care, transportation, and dementia programs. It has no connection to household or community water or sanitation service access (E01) and presents no empirical research.
plain_vs_narrow_note: Excluded under both narrow and plain Criterion 2 readings because the record is an editorial guest-editor profile on elder care and aging services, completely unrelated to water or sanitation service access.

evidence_quotes.quote: Johnson profiles Richard Browdie, who has worked for thirty years for the good of the older people through management of government and community care organizations.
As Pennsylvania's secretary of aging, Browdie fostered collaboration with the service organizations across the state
